# Oneiro — Live Greek Band (Detroit, MI)

> Oneiro is a four-piece Greek-American band based in Detroit, Michigan, performing live Greek music for weddings, baptisms, Greek festivals, glendia, dances & galas, taverna nights, and corporate/private events across North America and beyond. 60+ five-star reviews across Google and Facebook. Booking: Booking@OneiroMusic.com · 586.943.2710.

## Key facts

- Four-piece band, est. 2007: Yianni (keyboards, lead vocals, founding member), Andreas (bouzouki, vocals), Dimitris (guitar, founding member), Sotiris (drums, percussion)
- Repertoire spans every Greek tradition — laïka, dimotika, nisiótika, rebetika, éntehno — plus today's hits
- Always the full band (no solo or trio offering); DJ service available by request between sets at weddings and events
- Based in Detroit, Michigan; performs across Michigan and travels nationwide and to destination events (recent/upcoming: Las Vegas NV, Scottsbluff NE, Nassau Bahamas, Grand Rapids MI, Plymouth MI)
- Reviews: 5.0 stars on Google (27 reviews), 100% recommend on Facebook (33 reviews) — 60+ five-star reviews total
- Tagline: "The Best in Live Greek Entertainment" — "Bring us the event, we'll bring you the kefi."
